## LinkedIn lookup (optional)
Resolves a LinkedIn URL from the email when a lead has none, then feeds it to Twain. The whole block is DISABLED by default.
To turn it on: pick ONE provider node below, add its API-key credential (Header Auth), adjust the response field in `Apply Resolved LinkedIn` if needed, and ENABLE that one node.
Nodes are pre-configured with each provider's API URL/auth/body:
• Findymail (default) — POST reverse-email · `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`
• Apollo — POST people/match · `X-Api-Key`
• People Data Labs — GET person/enrich · `X-Api-Key`
• Proxycurl — GET resolve/email · `Authorization: Bearer`
Twain also resolves LinkedIn from the email during research; this is for resolving it BEFORE Twain or with your own provider.

parameters.content:
## LinkedIn Signal Outreach — a researched, personalized draft the moment a lead is in-market

When a buying signal fires (a form, a HubSpot list, a webhook), this workflow turns it into a **ready-to-send LinkedIn intro + follow-ups** in your Slack about 20 seconds later — you review and send from your own profile. It never auto-sends.

### Why Twain
The research is what makes outreach land and what doesn't scale — 10+ hours of profile-reading for a week of leads, so it gets skipped and the copy gets generic. Twain's campaign **Agent** reads each person and their company and writes the message on a real angle, from a brief you set once in plain language. Same research and personalization a good rep would do by hand, in seconds, at list scale.

### What it does
• Normalizes the signal, dedupes, and (optionally) resolves a LinkedIn URL from the email
• Calls Twain to research the lead and draft the LinkedIn intro + follow-ups
• Posts the draft to Slack for a human to send — optionally stages it in a HeyReach campaign

### How to set up
1. Twain account + a LinkedIn intro/follow-up campaign at **https://www.twain.ai** — its Agent writes the copy.
2. Paste the `campaign_id` into **LinkedIn Settings**; add the Twain (Header Auth `X-Api-Key`) + Slack credentials.
3. Point your signal source at the webhook. Generate/Sequence costs 1 credit per lead.

Built with Twain — https://www.twain.ai

### 1 · Signal intake & setup
A buying signal hits the **webhook** (a form, a HubSpot list, any tool that means "reach out now"). Set your Twain campaign in **LinkedIn Settings** (`campaign_id`) — its Agent writes the copy.
**Wire:** Twain Header Auth (`X-Api-Key`) + Slack. Webhook auth starts at `none`; add a shared secret before going live. Generate/Sequence = 1 credit per lead.

### 2 · Normalize & dedupe
Parse the signal into a clean lead, then skip anyone already processed (dedupe by a stable id). Reruns are safe.

### 4 · Generate with Twain
Twain researches the lead and drafts the LinkedIn intro + follow-ups from your campaign's Agent. Retries handle 429s. For research-heavy volume, switch to `POST /v2/Generate/Contact/Async` with a callback so a cold-lead generation can't hit the 60s gateway timeout.

### 5 · Review & route
The draft is posted to **Slack for a human to send** — this template never auto-sends.
• Free LinkedIn: message 1st-degree connections + limited invites. Cold non-connections need InMail (Sales Navigator).
• n8n has no native LinkedIn DM node, so sending stays manual.

Optional (disabled): **Push to HeyReach** stages the copy in a HeyReach campaign — set `heyreach_campaign_id` in *LinkedIn Settings*. Runs through your LinkedIn account; ToS/ban risk, Sales Navigator recommended.

### HubSpot segment source (optional · disabled)
Drive this from HubSpot instead of the webhook: a contact entering a dynamic list is the signal. Enable *Schedule → List memberships (v3) → Read contacts → Map → LinkedIn Settings*.
Auth: a HubSpot **Service Key** / private-app token in a **Bearer Auth** credential — not OAuth2 (n8n blocks it in HTTP nodes). Scopes: `crm.lists.read` + `crm.objects.contacts.read`. Set your list id (replace `REPLACE_WITH_HUBSPOT_LIST_ID`). Keep disabled until configured.
